name: security-recipes.ai
tagline: Turn CVE intelligence into verified, evidence-backed remediation teams can trust.
description: Open, self-hostable knowledge layer linking source-backed CVE research to bounded remediation recipes, required evidence, rollback guidance, and human-reviewed outcomes—built for security leaders who need traceable action, not another alert stream.

name: OSS Dependency Explorer
tagline: Map multi-ecosystem dependencies and surface supply-chain risk before production.
description: Supply-chain visibility for security and engineering leaders: maps package dependencies across eight ecosystems and combines vulnerability, repository health, license, and SBOM analysis so risk is triaged before it ships.

name: Shiba Studio
tagline: Local-first studio to build, govern, and audit production-ready AI agents.
description: Unifies agent orchestration, workspace-aware coding, browser control, scheduling, integrations, memory, and auditable local workflows—so organizations automate with AI without surrendering data control or auditability.

name: Stevo.AI
tagline: Governed AI operations that critique, revise, and ship only under CI controls.
description: Live proof of agentic content operations with control at every step: an AI advisor reframes copy under code-enforced factual guards, opens a pull request, passes CI, merges, and deploys—evidence for leaders evaluating governed AI enablement.

name: Pro Response
tagline: Raise enterprise message quality with AI inside Slack and existing channels.
description: Selects among multiple model providers per request so quality, cost, and policy can be balanced. Staff get rewrite, translation, summary, and format help without a new workplace surface.

name: Spare Cycles
tagline: Pool multi-provider inference across volunteer nodes to study routing without vendor lock-in.
description: Volunteer contributors attach Claude, GPT, Grok, or local Ollama capacity. An OpenAI-compatible front door lets teams examine orchestration, failover, and provider mixing without building their own mesh.

name: Tiny Book Buddies AI
tagline: Idea to illustrated, narrated children's storybook—entirely in the browser.
description: A parent chooses a model provider; the studio writes the story, generates illustrations, narrates with word-level highlighting, and exports a finished video book. End-to-end consumer product, nothing to host.

name: Sonny’s World
tagline: A bilingual English–Spanish learning playground for a small child, with living picture-book videos.
description: A bilingual English and Spanish playground for a young child aged two to five: letters, numbers, words, songs, sign language, and living picture-book videos, built for a grandparent and a small person to sit and learn together.

name: mouseclicker.app
tagline: Portable Windows auto-clicker with record/replay and optional AI patterns.
description: Humanized cursor movement and global hotkeys sit on top of system-wide record and replay, with optional pattern generation from a cloud or local model. Shipped as a finished desktop utility.

name: Desert Wander Supply Co.
tagline: Southwest outdoor gear storefront for desert travel and EDC.
description: A merchandised retail catalog with hosted checkout and email capture, taken from a niche outdoor concept through payment and fulfilment as a live store.

name: Arizona Now
tagline: Source-linked Arizona events and local-business listings.
description: Curated, source-linked listings and local-business directory space, browsable by city, calendar, or map, with featured placements for standout events and businesses.

name: DOGE Commerce Kit
tagline: Non-custodial toolkit for accepting Dogecoin in person or online.
description: Browser wallet tools, counter checkout, payment QR codes, on-chain confirmation, and a local order ledger keep acceptance under the merchant's control from the counter to the web.

name: Arrowhead Paesano
tagline: Automated weekly game-preview desk for the Arrowhead Paesano Chiefs channel.
description: Produces a sourced weekly preview with matchups, projections, and a shoot-ready run-of-show, and publishes channel playback from a checked-in snapshot so the property stays current between recordings.

name: DOGE MINER
tagline: Mine to a Dogecoin pool with live shares, hardware stats, and on-chain wallet data in view.
description: Submits work to a public pool, tracks share acceptance, and shows hardware plus on-chain wallet figures in one dashboard—hashing through pool response and wallet state as a single product.
